<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court defers ECI case:</strong> The Supreme Court has granted petitioners 10 days to respond to the Election Commission’s affidavit defending its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process and the functioning of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, with the next hearing scheduled for November 17.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxOdWFNaVpTOXZIU09iMHVkdHF5enRkVU1sdzRtNEg5eTNVbkNHVWFpVTFkWFpHUlgyd0FhbzZmN25wMWRGTmNCYzZac3lKblI1Zng0VmN6aEJDUHJJVHRoSVg1dkFXZjBCWk1OR2RSV3gtclNhWkdXUHYzRjd6azRtRTg5cjYtTWZmNndFVTRVMzhlcWkwMW5kNk5NdDB0ajc5VEloOU9xRHNGb2d3OXZieGFaalNhTVRlTE4ycDVtXzVHZDQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political fallout over remarks:</strong> The BJP is holding nationwide protests against Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge for his remarks regarding PM Modi’s late father, while the Congress party continues to face friction with authorities over its planned protests against the ECI.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges ECI:</strong> Opposition parties have marched to the Supreme Court demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner, while Congress has separately sought a court-monitored probe into alleged theft of donations at the Ram temple.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral and administrative updates:</strong> Counting is underway for four Karnataka MLC seats in a high-stakes contest between the BJP-JD(S) alliance and Congress, while the Union Cabinet is expected to consider a dearness allowance hike for central government employees on October 28.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
</ul>
